confirmedFindings.rule: MDC-060 data trust; unresolved/fatal/retained/paused evidence must not masquerade as a successfully empty response
relatedEvidence: FirmwareCanaryPage.tsx:33-35 derives latest from the query and :137-139 forwards only quality/evidence/limitations
web\src\features\advanced-intelligence\components\EvidencePanel.tsx:14-19 has no query/source-state input

EvidencePanel.tsx:99 says No supporting evidence was returned; :115 says No additional limitations were returned
web\src\features\advanced-intelligence\components\InsightPanel.tsx:43-47 defaults a query-less, nonempty panel to ready
InsightPanel.tsx:61-80 attaches freshness and retained warnings only when query is supplied
confirmedFindings.mechanism: The decision panel receives the firmware query, but its companion evidence panel discards that source state. During initial loading, paused initial reads or fatal reads, latest is absent and the evidence panel renders successful-empty-response wording. Retained quality/evidence also has no local stale/refresh-failure annotation. The main decision panel's warning does not make these independent evidence statements true.
sourceDerivedRepro: Consider a selected synthetic vehicle with an unresolved firmware query: data is undefined and isLoading is true.
Follow latest=null into EvidencePanel: quality/evidence/limitations become undefined, collections default to empty and its nested InsightPanel resolves ready.
The decision shell shows loading, while EvidencePanel asserts that no evidence and no additional limitations were returned even though no response has resolved.
The same evidence wording is produced for an initial paused or fatal read. With retained data plus refresh failure, quality can remain sufficient without a local trust warning.
confirmedFindings.fix: A separately owned narrow domain-component/caller change should forward the same source query/trust into EvidencePanel and its existing InsightPanel. Preserve all three evidence subsection shells; distinguish no-selection, unresolved/paused/fatal, successfully empty and retained states using current shared state/retry APIs.
confirmedFindings.owner: advanced-intelligence EvidencePanel/caller integration; shared trust primitives remain unchanged

confirmedFindings.rule: Trustworthy decision rationale; do not claim matched peer evidence where only a target window is supported
relatedEvidence: FirmwareCanaryPage.tsx:109-116 selects the matched-peer rationale for every decision except insufficient
internal\app\advancedintelligencesvc\twin_firmware.go:321-326 only populates peer_regression_pct and matched_excess_pct when hasPeers is true
twin_firmware.go:359-374 emits limited quality and investigate for target-only regression >5, with peer/excess fields still null
The backend explicitly returns the limitation that a target-only change cannot support rollout or hold without a contemporaneous matched cohort
confirmedFindings.mechanism: A valid target-only investigate decision takes the page's supported branch, which says the decision reflects target regression relative to the matched peer change. The actual service can make this decision without a supported matched peer change. The null metric tiles and lower limitation do not correct the false affirmative rationale.
sourceDerivedRepro: Consider a source-valid window with at least five drives in each target window, positive pre efficiency and >5% target regression, but fewer than ten peer drives per peer window.
BuildFirmwareCanary's hasPeers=false branch emits decision=investigate, quality=limited and null peer/excess percentages.
The page checks only decision !== insufficient and displays the matched-peer rationale, despite those peer fields being unsupported.
confirmedFindings.fix: A narrow page-only rationale change should inspect the actual nullable peer/excess evidence or quality before making a matched-peer claim. Keep the backend's investigate decision, thresholds, raw percentages and limitations unchanged; disclose target-only evidence instead of inventing rollout readiness.
